Dinesh (Partnerships): Heads up — found a mismatch between the SKU tags Marketing received and the HW partner's final SKU list for H200 / MI300 in APAC. Also one of the Gaudi images will need a driver hotfix. We should align before next co-marketing sync.
Emma (PM): Ugh. Do we know which SKUs? timeline?
Dinesh (Partnerships): Short list: partner provided `H200-48G-v2` but marketing assets say `H200-48G`. MI300 shows as `MI300-128` vs partner's `MI300-128A` in the marketplace manifest. Hotfix causes a 48-72h CI retest for Gaudi images.
Leah (Infra): The driver hotfix on Gaudi affects our CI image tags: `gaudi-main:2026-03-20` -> needs rebuild. ETA for warm rebuild is ~36h once vendor artifact lands.
Marta (Marketing): We already scheduled asset localization for APAC docs on Monday. If tags change we need a freeze or we'll have wrong SKU text in the marketplace listing. Can we freeze copy until confirmed? :grimacing:
Sam (Ops): For billing and SKU mapping, payments team needs the exact SKU string by Wednesday EOD PST. If we change `-v2` vs not it'll break reconciliation.
Dinesh (Partnerships): Agreed on freeze. I'll ask vendor legal/PM to confirm canonical SKU strings today. I pinged NVIDIA & SI contacts.
Dinesh (Partnerships): @Leah can you share the failing CI job logs? might help vendor triage.
Leah (Infra): Paste of failing step: ```
ERROR: kernel-module mismatch: expected kv4.1.3, found kv4.0.9
Action: apply vendor driver patch 2026-03-19-gi
Re-run: ./ci/run_infra_tests.sh --image gaudi-main:2026-03-20
```
Marta (Marketing): If rebuild pushes past Wed we need contingency: update the marketplace copy to use the generic family name (e.g., "H200 family") instead of SKU-specific. Not ideal but prevents bad listings. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sam (Ops): Contingency works but create a tracking ticket so we revert to exact SKU when stable. Also we should map both SKU variants in billing (canonical -> aliases) to avoid charge mismatches.
Emma (PM): Let's do a 30m alignment call at 4:30pm PT. Agenda: confirm canonical SKUs, CI hotfix status, marketing freeze + fallback copy, billing alias mapping. I'll send invite.
Dinesh (Partnerships): Invite sent to vendor PMs + SI lead. Quick ask to vendors in thread: can you confirm canonical SKU strings for H200/MI300/Gaudi and share hotfix artifact link?
deploy-bot: Scheduled meeting created: partnerships/sku-alignment 2026-03-18T23:30:00Z.
Dinesh (Partnerships): Vendor reply (from partner PM in DM): "Can confirm canonical SKUs: `H200-48G-v2`, `MI300-128A`. Hotfix artifact: https://vendor.example.com/gaudi/patch-2026-03-19.tar.gz. We will push signed container tomorrow morning UTC."
Leah (Infra): Got the artifact link. I'll start rebuild tomorrow morning and flag any regression immediately.
Marta (Marketing): OK locking copy until EOD Thu PT. If vendor pushes signed container by tomorrow we'll proceed with localized assets Mon morning.
Sam (Ops): I'll add alias mapping in billing: canonical -> [aliases] for the three SKUs. Will validate with finance before EOD Wed.
Emma (PM): Thanks team — follow-ups: Leah posts CI green, Dinesh confirms vendor signed container, Sam posts billing mapping PR, Marta posts locked copy location. We'll reconvene if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
Dinesh (Partnerships): Noted. Thanks everyone.
